requirements.candidate_label: Normal-path redirection uses appropriate TTC treatment
requirements.subject: Road-user path through the left-lane closure
requirements.relation: is directed from the normal path to the new path with appropriate channelizing devices, traffic control devices, and/or TTC methods
requirements.threshold: Appropriate redirection treatment is present wherever redirection is required; no numeric threshold
applicability_conditions: A non-mobile TTC operation requires redirection of road users’ normal path
Scene has one left lane closed on the four-lane undivided roadway
required_inputs: Field observation of the lane-closure path and installed TTC treatment
requirements.source_span: Except for mobile operations, when redirection of the road users’ normal path is required, road users shall be directed from the normal path to a new path with appropriate channelizing devices, traffic control devices, and/or TTC methods.

requirements.candidate_label: Downstream taper length is within the temporary-TTC range
requirements.subject: Downstream taper
requirements.threshold: At least 50 ft and no more than 100 ft
applicability_conditions: A downstream taper is present in the selected TA-30 lane-closure layout
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-3. Taper Length Criteria for Temporary Traffic Control Zones. Merging Taper: at least L. Shifting Taper: at least 0.5 L. Shoulder Taper: at least 0.33 L. One-Lane, Two-Way Traffic Taper: 50 feet minimum, 100 feet maximum. Downstream Taper: 50 feet minimum, 100 feet maximum.

requirements.candidate_label: ROAD WORK AHEAD is first when multiple advance-warning signs are used
requirements.subject: Advance warning sign sequence on the approach to the transition and activity area
requirements.relation: has ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) as the first sign encountered by road users
requirements.threshold: ROAD WORK AHEAD is first whenever multiple advance warning signs are needed
applicability_conditions: Multiple advance warning signs are installed on the approach to the transition and activity area
required_inputs: Observed order of advance warning signs along the approach
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
